v: This world-famous horse venue was once a cattle feedlot.
Marg and Ron Southern opened Spruce Meadows, just south of Calgary, in nineteen seventy-five.
In nineteen eighty-one, its new grand prix was the richest in the world.
Today, it's one of only four venues in show jumping's Rolex Grand Slam.
And most days, the grounds are free to visit.
